label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 104 ]

blocks.text: Mexico attracts different types of visitors. One group is composed of artists. As admirers of the Mexican culture, they want to be close to the subjects they are writing about or painting. Another group consists of retirees who also need to live on reduced incomes. They like the unhurried way of life with its long afternoon nap and they enjoy the temperate climate. The third group is attracted by the resort with its colorful night life. In Acapulco, they can play all night, and swim in the warm ocean water.

readingSentences.english: Mexico attracts different types of visitors.
One group is composed of artists. As admirers of the Mexican culture, they want to be close to the subjects they are writing about or painting.
readingSentences.korean: 한 부류는 예술가들이다. 멕시코 문화를 동경하는 그들은 자신이 글로 쓰거나 그리는 대상 가까이에 있고 싶어 한다.

readingSentences.english: Another group consists of retirees who also need to live on reduced incomes.
readingSentences.korean: 또 한 부류는 줄어든 수입으로 살아야 하는 은퇴자들이다.

readingSentences.english: They like the unhurried way of life with its long afternoon nap and they enjoy the temperate climate.
readingSentences.korean: 그들은 긴 낮잠을 즐기는 느긋한 생활 방식을 좋아하고 온화한 기후를 즐긴다.

readingSentences.english: The third group is attracted by the resort with its colorful night life.
readingSentences.korean: 세 번째 부류는 화려한 밤 문화가 있는 휴양지에 끌린다.

readingSentences.english: In Acapulco, they can play all night, and swim in the warm ocean water.
readingSentences.korean: 아카풀코에서 그들은 밤새 놀고 따뜻한 바닷물에서 수영할 수 있다.
